practices.practice: Read the cluster connection string from an environment variable (do not commit or log it) and provide a .env.example or ignored .env file for local development.

practices.practice: Reuse a single shared Mongoose/MongoClient connection (one connection pool per process) rather than opening new connections per request.

practices.practice: Create indexes only for queryable fields and manage index creation as part of deployment (createIndexes/createIndexes scripts), and consider building indexes after bulk ingestion to speed initial data load.

practices.practice: Create a single-field or compound index on the normalized pair key (e.g., normalizedPair) so pairwise lookups use an index instead of a collection scan.
practices.prior_belief: Create a single-field index on the canonical pair key (pairKey: 1) and/or a compound index on [drugA, drugB] if you store ordered pairs, so pairwise lookups use an index and avoid collection scans.

practices.practice: When querying many pairwise keys, issue a single query that uses $in on the indexed normalized pair field (normalizedPair: { $in: [...] }) to leverage the index and avoid N per-pair round trips.
practices.prior_belief: When you must query many pairwise interactions for a medication list, issue a single query that $in matches the list of canonical pair keys (pairKey in [...]) to leverage the index and avoid N per-pair round trips.

practices.practice: Store embedding vectors in a dedicated numeric array field (e.g., embedding) and create a vector index on that path before running vector searches.

practices.practice: Implement client-side retries with exponential backoff and jitter for transient network errors and throttling, and limit the retry count.

practices.practice: Detect and handle RequestRateTooLarge / HTTP 429 responses explicitly: respect Retry-After headers, back off (exponential + jitter), and avoid aggressive retries when the cluster is throttling.

practices.practice: Avoid unbounded documents and large unbounded arrays; respect the 16 MB document size limit and model one interaction per document or otherwise bound array growth.
